meta.title: Terminal suggest: Move storage from globalState to globalStorageUri
meta.body_summary: Migrate terminal-suggest shell completion cache from context.globalState Memento to context.globalStorageUri filesystem to eliminate large extension state warning (3840KB).

perf_labels.notes: Copilot migrated large cache from globalState to globalStorageUri after smoke test warning; Tyriar requested cache files saved in subfolder; fix applied and merged with three approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 39 changed lines in one file, this is a very small, surgical edit. It fits a targeted storage migration performance fix and the quick merge after review is consistent.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Tyriar CHANGES_REQUESTED: the cache files should be placed inside a terminal-suggest/ subdirectory within globalStorageUri. Copilot fixed it in commit 69e8627.
review_details.performance_claim: Migrating from in-memory Memento to on-disk filesystem storage eliminates the large extension state warning and follows best practices.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple storage backend migration was successfully performed; the only maintainer request was to organize cache files in a subfolder.

detection_detail.code_reading: Tyriar reviewed the storage migration and requested saving cache files in a terminal-suggest/ subfolder.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR cites a smoke test warning with exact KB size, but no timing or benchmark before/after.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, Copilot moved cache to subfolder and meganrogge removed extraneous args; then merged.

core_change_summary.description: In extensions/terminal-suggest/src/terminalSuggestMain.ts, switched cache storage from globalState Memento to globalStorageUri filesystem: replaced globalStorage.update/get with vscode.workspace.fs writeFile/readFile, added createDirectory and JSON serialization, and placed cache in terminal-suggest/ subdirectory.
change_trajectory: First implementation using globalStorageUri with root-level cache file.
After review, moved cache to terminal-suggest/ subdirectory.

review_signals.summary: Formal CHANGES_REQUESTED review with no body; feedback delivered via inline comment.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot moved cache to subfolder in follow-up commits.

review_signals.summary: Requested that cache files be saved inside a terminal-suggest/ subdirectory.
review_signals.action_taken: Commit 69e8627 moved cache to terminal-suggest/ subdirectory.
